prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a carer speaking for a member. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"Where a member asks a carer to speak on their behalf, we will normally deal with the carer only after the member has given clear permission.
